$comment: Newest first. Read by agents (agentcms status) to tell users what changed and what to run. `breaking`: an older admin, skill or site setup stops working without action. `actions`: steps a hosted site needs after updating — deploy-admin, regenerate-all, sync-theme-assets. Keep every entry in English.

changes: The CLI reads plugin and theme bundles straight from the hosting (repo head / bucket) instead of the served admin: right after an install or upgrade, while a Pages host or CDN still serves the old version, pages are rendered with the new bundle. A bundle whose version differs from the site's registry is reported.

Fix: on a new site whose hosting doesn't serve the admin yet (Cloudflare / GitHub Pages project not connected or still building), commands loaded no plugin at all — pages were published without sitemaps, RSS or SEO and `plugins disable` said the plugin didn't exist. `ext install` could also record a registry without the bundled plugins.
Fix: commands for two different sites run in one process (ext install followed by its regeneration, tests) could write to the first site's hosting.
`ext install` regenerates the whole site when the package is activated or upgrades the active theme / an enabled plugin (`--no-regenerate` to skip), and its `next` steps give CLI commands.
`doctor` reports a pending deployment (the served home page differs from the one on the hosting).
`media upload --data @media.json` gives each file its own alt text / caption; every upload command is now a single commit (one Pages build).
`media regenerate`: re-crops existing media to the active theme's formats after a theme switch (plan first, `--yes`).
Screenshots (`site screenshot`, `ext preview --screenshots`, `content preview --screenshots`) scroll through each page first, so scroll-triggered reveal animations show; `ext preview --max-height`.
`ext preview` runs the bundled plugins (SEO, sitemaps, RSS, archives, search…), so `--site` previews render like the live site (translated archive link, search).
Portfolio theme 0.2.0: the related-projects section under each project is styled, translated and filtered by category; the black-and-white hero photo can be turned off (Theme settings → Single).
`ext new` scaffolds only the translation keys of the features you pick; docs: Cloudflare Pages setup (connect after install, turn off preview branches), tags are names, scroll animations in themes.

Site administration from the CLI and the new agent skill agentcms-admin: everything the back office does — content (create, update, translations, publish / unpublish / delete, preview with screenshots, editor blocks), media upload (WebP variants made in Node), categories and tags, menus, settings, plugins (enable / disable / config / settings-page actions: favicon, sitemaps, RSS, search, import…), themes (activate, config, logo, sync assets), every Regenerate menu entry, users and author profiles, export / import and stats. Commands: content, media, terms, menus, settings, plugins, themes, regenerate, users, transfer, stats.

Firebase sites: `agentcms install` can install on Firebase, `site add` registers an existing Firebase site, and the sign-in is kept between commands (~/.agentcms/sessions, mode 0600) so bursts of commands no longer hit Firebase's sign-in rate limit.
`agentcms site screenshot [path…]` captures published pages (desktop + phone); `site list` shows each site's public URL.
Fix: republishing an entry, Repair URLs and Regenerate all no longer reset its publication date to now.

Fix: with a static home page, sitemaps, the search index, menus and posts.json no longer list or link `/<home-slug>.html` (a 404), and with agentcms-multilang a language's home page is no longer duplicated at `/<lang>/<slug>.html`. Regenerate everything now also deletes translation files a plugin stopped producing.
Fix: Columns and HTML blocks published from the CLI (or any headless publish) kept their raw markers and had no CSS; they are now transformed without a browser DOM.
Fix: the WordPress importer works headless (namespaced tags, CDATA).
Fix: `ext preview --screenshot-js` did nothing in the published CLI (the build dropped the branch).
Default robots.txt disallows the admin under the site's sub-folder; slugs spell out œ, æ, ß, ø… (oeuvre, not uvre); RSS regeneration reports what it uploaded.
`agentcms files list / put / delete`: other files on the hosting (a search-engine verification file, a stray old page); the CMS's own files are protected.
S3 sites served over plain http: `install`, `site list` and `doctor` give the admin's HTTPS address (the bucket's endpoint), where the admin can sign its requests.
RSS: pages link their feed in <head> (rel=alternate) so feed readers discover it; category archives also link their category feed.
Search: the modal no longer shows two close buttons and takes the theme's accent color.
Admin updates now refresh the version of the bundled plugins and themes in the site's registry, so browsers load the new bundles instead of a cached copy.

`users get me` works before the profile exists; `credentials list` shows which site uses a passphrase; `media` reports how each format is cut (`fit`) and which ones are admin-only; `site screenshot --max-height`; `settings set` warns when agentcms-multilang's primary language differs from the site language.

Categories: `terms delete --move-to <category>` moves the posts and republishes them in one go; `terms update --slug … --remove-archive` (or `--old-slug`) deletes the old archive; `menus update` edits one menu item; renames, moves and deletions warn about menu labels and about links stored in theme / plugin settings or menus that still point to the old page, with the exact fix.
Bundled plugin versions: agentcms-sitemaps 1.0.1, agentcms-rss 1.1.0, agentcms-search 1.0.1, agentcms-archives 1.0.1, agentcms-multilang 1.6.4.

Fix: published pages load the site's own images with root-relative URLs, so they show whatever address the visitor uses (an http S3 website opened over the bucket's https endpoint used to block them as mixed content). Regenerate everything to apply.

Magazine theme: the home page's fixed texts are now settings — featured badge, latest-posts heading and "Most read" heading (Theme settings → Home, or `themes config magazine --merge '{"home":{"latestHeading":"…"}}'`).

`agentcms doctor` no longer reports a non-AgentCMS page (README, previous site) as a working home page, and tells to wait for the Pages build before redeploying theme assets; `install` names the content folder of Markdown repos and lists the first settings of a new site.

Fix: `agentcms ext check` / `ext preview` crashed when run from the npm package ("Cannot find module '@mixmark-io/domino'") — the CLI bundle now has no runtime dependency outside itself, guarded by a test.
Fix: projects made by `agentcms ext new` now install and type-check with a plain `npm install` (.npmrc legacy-peer-deps, react-i18next / i18next types, @tiptap/pm for blocks).
Releases now smoke-test every scaffold variant against the packed package with a real npm install.

Flexweg support removed: the Flexweg SQLite data backend, the Flexweg hosting, the PHP bridge (own server) and the dashboard storage card are gone. Data: SQLite file, Markdown in git, Firebase or this browser. Hosting: GitHub/GitLab/Cloudflare Pages, S3-compatible buckets, local folder or ZIP.

Internal names no longer mention Flexweg: plugins are agentcms-* (agentcms-sitemaps, agentcms-rss, …), external bundles import @agent-cms/runtime (CMS_API_VERSION), config.js sets window.__AGENTCMS_CONFIG__, browser keys start with agentcms. FlexwegApiError and getStorageLimits are removed from the runtime API.
New AgentCMS logo and admin favicon.

New agent skill agentcms-extensions and CLI `agentcms ext`: scaffold a plugin or theme project (ext new), validate it exactly as the admin loads and publishes it (ext check: bundle imports, manifest, hooks, editor-block round trip, a demo site rendered by the real publisher), render a demo site with desktop/phone screenshots (ext preview, --site renders a site's real content read-only), pack the ZIP (ext pack) and install, list or uninstall extensions on a registered site (ext install / list / uninstall).
The npm package ships types/agentcms-runtime.d.ts: complete, documented TypeScript types of @agent-cms/runtime for external plugins and themes.
Saving a theme's settings page now re-uploads its compiled CSS (compileCss), so style changes are live without Sync theme assets.
admin-files.json records the extension API version of the hosted admin.

Extension API: AuthorView.url (author archive link for templates), the editor's pickMedia() now also returns the media id, markdownToPlainText separates block elements with spaces. Bundled examples and in-tree theme/plugin versions are consistent; external examples use the shared types.
Sites and external plugins/themes made with 0.1.x must be reinstalled (or rebuilt against @agent-cms/runtime): their config.js, plugin settings and browser keys use the old names.

Renamed to AgentCMS everywhere: admin (title, header, setup wizard, terms — 7 languages), the generator meta tag of published pages, config.js header, commit messages, docs and examples. Stored identifiers (export format, browser keys, plugin ids, @flexweg/cms-runtime) are unchanged, so existing sites and exports keep working.
First release as the @agent-cms/agentcms npm package (command agentcms) and Claude Code plugin (skills agentcms-install and agentcms-manage).

agentcms install --plan: installs a site from a JSON plan (SQLite file or Markdown in GitHub/GitLab, on GitHub/GitLab/Cloudflare Pages, S3-compatible buckets, Flexweg or an own PHP server) — content store, publish target, theme assets and the admin in one go.

SQLite databases are encrypted by default (AES-256-GCM, passphrase asked once per browser) and can be stored in a separate private location (bucket or repo) — a static host serves the file like any page. `doctor` flags a downloadable plain database.
Settings → Data backend: encrypt an existing SQLite database or change its passphrase; `agentcms compact-data` shrinks a git data branch to one commit.
Several sites per computer: site list/show/use/rename/forget/add, credentials stored per account (never per site, never in the chat).
agentcms status / doctor / deploy-admin: version overview, health checks with fixes, and confirmed admin updates (downgrades refused).
agentcms serve runs the admin on your computer for the setup wizard (Firebase, this browser, local folder, ZIP).
